metadata.unit: One reported action, result, communication, decision or investigative finding; aggregate actions retained only where individual records are unavailable
metadata.counts_are: Displayable entries, not total raw actions or independently verified unique log events
metadata.schema: events are flat records; supplementary sources and conflicts are separate tables
metadata.time_policy: Never use a source episode anchor as the exact time of every component event. Context interval bounds are analyst placement aids, not observed start/end times.
metadata.epistemic_policy: Established in cited account means the source reports occurrence; it is not independent ground truth. Reasoning does not establish cause.
metadata.severity_policy: Provisional analyst ordinal adverse-effect scale 0–5; null has an explicit label and reason. Not CVSS, not an OECD scale, not an estimate of total harm.
metadata.null_policy: JSON null and empty typed CSV/XLSX cell mean unavailable or inapplicable; companion precision, basis, label and uncertainty fields explain why.
metadata.causal_graph: No causal edges inferred automatically from chronology
metadata.original_sources: Three user-supplied starter documents plus public primary-source additions
limitations: Not a proven absolute maximum. Further releases may add events.
Aggregate counts, chart cells and anonymous raw activity totals are not expanded into invented individual events.
Multiple sources can describe overlapping stages. Source claims and conflict notes are retained.
Categorical fields and severity are provisional analyst coding, with explicit classification rules and specific overrides.
Full private transcripts and detailed logs are not publicly accessible.

conflicts.subject: Private-repository CI execution
conflicts.detail: OpenAI reports a draft PR triggering CI/network beacon. HF says execution policies blocked CI compromise and no malicious change shipped. Execution, compromise and release are different claims; full logs are needed to reconcile.

conflicts.subject: Connector network path
conflicts.detail: HF prose says the internal Kubernetes connector was reached directly from the worker, not through the mesh. The replay labels a July 12 SOCKS connector query. They may refer to different connectors or requests.

codebook.definition: Stable event-entry identifier. E0001–E0822 preserve the earlier inventory; E0823–E0832 are new. IDs are not chronological ranks.
One short report-derived description. An action, result, statement, decision or investigative finding can be its own displayable event.
Actor phrase from the source-derived description. Generic agents are not assigned invented identities.
Analyst classification: AI agent; organization or human team; software or system; not individually identified.
Only named where supported. An IM1-dominated cohort is not proof that every individual was IM1.
Reported verb phrase including relevant qualifiers. Does not imply successful completion unless the source says so.
Provisional analyst category for filtering. Communication, decisions, failures and investigations remain distinguishable.
Normalized system context. In particular, HF datasets-server MongoDB differs from the private Hub database.
Provisional workstream or narrative phase. Phases can overlap in time.
Precursor, incident activity, decision/coordination, response/mitigation or investigation/aftermath. A layout category, not a causal conclusion.
Performed, observed result, observed absence or stated decision. A stated decision is not an executed action.
Established in cited account means the source reports it, not independent verification. Other labels identify reasoning or differing accounts.
Calendar date attributed to the event or dated passage. Null when only a broad context interval is known.
Time stated for a single timeline entry or reconstructed record. Null for actions with only an episode anchor. See precision and basis.
Minute, day, source estimated milliseconds, or context interval. Printed millisecond precision does not imply millisecond accuracy.
How the date or time was obtained: source entry, explicit event date, dated section, reconstructed estimate, or analyst bounds.
Inclusive lower calendar bound for narrative context. Not the event start time; null means no defensible lower bound assigned.
Exclusive upper calendar bound for narrative context. Not an observed end time. An upper bound of July 14 includes July 13.
UTC timestamp assigned by the source to a multi-action episode. Never automatically assign it to every component action.
Readable source time or original inventory time reference. Unknown timing is stated explicitly.
What this row establishes about its action/result. An attempt, failed request, message or decision does not establish a successful intrusion.
Provisional analyst adverse-effect level 0–5. Null for unknown, disputed, unassessed or inapplicable effects. See accompanying label and rationale.
Explains a numeric level or why severity is not numeric. A zero is not an unknown.
Row-level reason for the assigned level. Importance of a response is not measured by adverse severity.
Identifies this as provisional analyst coding. It is not CVSS, an official OECD rating or a probability.
Actual intervention or not an intervention entry. Supports a separate response view.
Explicitly not assigned in this historical dataset. Counterfactual recommendations were not invented or counted as events.
Chronological ordering and model narration do not establish causation. No automatic causal edges are supplied.
Foreign key to the source catalog.
PDF page, talk timestamp, advisory identifier or section-topic/search guide. METR topic references are not raw-log coordinates.
Primary source URL for the reported entry.
Kind of published evidence: narrative, dated technical table, independent investigation, transcript, replay annotation or advisory.
Event paraphrase to help locate related source text. This field is NOT a verbatim quote.
Other locators retained when candidate entries were merged. Compact O/M/HF/B references follow the original inventory notation.
Groups atoms extracted from the same source episode/passage. It does not assert that the group is one causal chain.
Single reported unit or aggregate reported action. Aggregates cannot be expanded without individual records.
Explicit evidence, timing, identity and disagreement limitations for the entry.
All enriched classifications remain provisional analyst coding, even when occurrence is well attested.
Preserved extraction reference. O = OpenAI PDF page; M number = approximate working-text location, not a public page; HF = section; B = talk time.
Original counting-audit candidate. Some split entries share a candidate; newly researched entries have null.
1.0 for the 822-entry inventory, 1.1 for the ten new vendor events.
CVE mentioned by the source or linked as an explicitly labeled analyst association. Null means none assigned.
Separates an explicit source link, an analyst association, and an advisory-publication event.
Object/complement of the reported action, retaining qualifiers. Use with the normalized system_scope; it is not an entity identifier.
Explains how the target detail was extracted.

severity_scale: No adverse effect demonstrated by this event
A blocked request or negative finding; not proof the overall campaign was harmless.
Local discovery, planning support, tests or message exchange without larger effect established in that row.
Limited boundary crossing or integrity interference
Unauthorized access/transport or local tampering without demonstrated sensitive compromise in that row.
Sensitive credentials/data/source disclosure or code execution.
Root, cluster administration, or signing/administrative authority. Root in a sandbox is labeled by target scope.
Requires demonstrated wider destructive impact or human harm. No row has been assigned this level.
Unknown / not assessed / not applicable / disputed
See each row’s severity label and rationale. Never substitute zero.
